_note: Chapter 30 词汇卡内容。ipa = 音标; ex = 例句数组, 顺序与词表中该词出现的行序一致(多词性词给多个例句, 每个例句对应词性行); note = 用法提示/搭配。

ex.en: She accomplished more in one year than most people do in a decade.
ex.cn: 她一年做成的事，比大多数人十年做的还多。
ex.note: accomplish a task 完成任务；accomplish nothing 一事无成

ex.en: It actually costs less than the old model.
ex.cn: 它实际上比旧型号便宜。
ex.note: actually 表强调时译作“其实/竟然”

ex.en: She greeted her old teacher with obvious affection.
ex.cn: 她见到旧日老师时，明显的亲昵溢于言表。
ex.note: have affection for sb. 喜爱某人

ex.en: All of us were surprised by the news.
ex.cn: 这消息让我们所有人都吃了一惊。
ex.note: all of … 全部；not all 并非全都

ex.en: We analysed the results carefully before drawing any conclusion.
ex.cn: 得出任何结论之前，我们仔细分析了这些结果。
ex.note: analyse data 分析数据；analysis n. 分析

ex.en: It was raining, but she went out anyway.
ex.cn: 当时正在下雨，她还是出了门。
ex.note: anyhow 同义；anyway 表转折时译作“不过/反正”

ex.en: The building was designed by a young architect from Shanghai.
ex.cn: 这座楼由一位来自上海的年轻建筑师设计。
ex.note: architect 建筑师；architecture n. 建筑；建筑风格

ex.en: The whole school gathered in the assembly hall for the ceremony.
ex.cn: 全校师生在礼堂里集合参加典礼。
ex.note: assembly hall 礼堂；assembly line 流水线

ex.en: The offer was too attractive for him to turn down.
ex.cn: 这份条件太诱人了，他没法拒绝。
ex.note: be attractive to sb. 对某人有吸引力

ex.en: The weather was so bad that all the games were cancelled.
ex.cn: 天气太糟，所有比赛都取消了。
ex.note: a bad time 不好的时机；not bad 不错

ex.en: Basically, the two plans differ only in the order of the steps.
ex.cn: 基本上，这两个方案只是步骤顺序不同。
ex.note: basically = in general 基本上

ex.en: She begged her parents to let her study abroad.
ex.cn: 她苦苦请求父母让她出国留学。
ex.note: beg sb. for sth. 乞求某人某物；beg to do 恳求做某事

ex.en: He rode his bicycle to the station every morning.
ex.cn: 他每天早晨骑车去车站。
ex.note: ride a bicycle 骑自行车

ex.en: In April the cherry trees along the river are in full blossom.
ex.cn: 四月里，河边的樱树开得正盛。
ex.note: in blossom 开花（作谓语）

ex.en: The old pear tree blossomed overnight after the rain.
ex.cn: 一场雨后，老梨树一夜之间就开了花。
ex.note: blossom 也可比喻“发展、繁荣”

ex.en: A ticket to the capital costs only fifty yuan, and the return ticket is bound to be cheaper.
ex.cn: 去首都的票只要五十元，而往返票一定会更便宜。
ex.note: be bound to do 一定会；be bound for 开往……

ex.en: The horse bounded over the fence and disappeared into the field.
ex.cn: 那匹马跃过篱笆，消失在田野里。
ex.note: bound 与 bounce 同根，表示跳跃

ex.en: She swept the floor with a straw broom.
ex.cn: 她用一把竹扫帚扫了地。
ex.note: sweep with a broom 用扫帚扫

ex.en: He bought two cabbages and a bunch of spring onions at the market.
ex.cn: 他在市场上买了两个卷心菜和一把小葱。
ex.note: cucumber n. 黄瓜；cabbage soup 卷心菜汤

ex.en: The captain of the fishing boat knew every inlet along the coast.
ex.cn: 那位渔船船长熟悉沿岸的每一个小湾。
ex.note: captain 船长；队长；机长；上尉

ex.en: Nobody could explain the cause of the sudden rise in prices.
ex.cn: 没人能解释物价突然上涨的原因。
ex.note: the cause of … ……的原因；for the cause of 为了……的事业

ex.en: Careless handling caused the accident in the laboratory.
ex.cn: 操作不当导致了实验室里的那场事故。
ex.note: cause sb. to do 使某人做某事

ex.en: The English Channel is rough when the wind is in the north.
ex.cn: 刮北风时，英吉利海峡波涛汹涌。
ex.note: a channel for sb. 某方面的渠道；the Channel 英吉利海峡

ex.en: There was a sudden chill in the air before the storm.
ex.cn: 暴风雨来临之前，空气里忽然有一丝凉意。
ex.note: a chill in the air 寒意；catch a chill 受寒

ex.en: Chill the wine for an hour before you serve it.
ex.cn: 上菜前先把酒冰镇一个小时。
ex.note: chill sth. 使某物变冷；chilled 冰镇的

ex.en: She prefers classical music to anything played on a guitar.
ex.cn: 比起任何用吉他弹的东西，她更偏爱古典音乐。
ex.note: classical music 古典音乐；classical literature 古典文学

ex.en: The path was made of coarse gravel that crunched underfoot.
ex.cn: 那条小路铺着粗砾石，踩上去咯吱作响。
ex.note: coarse sand 粗砂；coarse manners 粗鲁的举止

ex.en: Foreign commerce has grown steadily since the port was opened.
ex.cn: 自从港口开放以来，对外贸易一直稳步增长。
ex.note: commerce 商业、贸易；commercial a. 商业的

ex.en: She composed the music for the school play in only two weeks.
ex.cn: 她只用两周就为校园剧写完了配乐。
ex.note: compose a poem 创作诗歌；compose oneself 使镇定

ex.en: After the interview he felt confident about the result.
ex.cn: 面试之后，他对结果很有信心。
ex.note: be confident of/about 对……有信心

ex.en: It took two years to construct the new bridge over the river.
ex.cn: 在河上架起那座新桥花了两年时间。
ex.note: construct 建造；construction n. 建造（业）

ex.en: The conversation at dinner went on long after the meal was finished.
ex.cn: 饭都吃完了，饭桌上的谈话还在继续。
ex.note: have a conversation with sb. 与某人交谈

ex.en: With more practice you could play far better than that.
ex.cn: 多练一练，你完全能弹得比那好得多。
ex.note: could 也可表示过去将来：could have done 本可以做到

ex.en: Ivy began to creep over the wall and cover the old windows.
ex.cn: 常春藤开始爬上矮墙，遮住了老旧的窗户。
ex.note: creep 爬行；蔓延；也可指蹑手蹑脚地走

ex.en: A curl of smoke rose from the chimney of the old house.
ex.cn: 一缕青烟从那座老屋的烟囱里升起。
ex.note: a curl of smoke 一缕烟；curl up 卷起身子

ex.en: They left the campsite long before dawn.
ex.cn: 他们远在黎明之前就离开了营地。
ex.note: before dawn 黎明前；at dawn 黎明时

ex.en: At last the truth began to dawn on him.
ex.cn: 真相终于开始在他心里显现。
ex.note: dawn on sb. 使某人开始明白

ex.en: A herd of deer grazed on the slope behind the chapel.
ex.cn: 一群鹿在教堂后面的斜坡上吃草。
ex.note: a herd of deer 一群鹿（deer 单复数同形）

ex.en: The whole project is dependent on funding from the city.
ex.cn: 整个项目都依赖于市里的拨款。
ex.note: be dependent on 依赖；依靠

ex.en: This small device can measure the temperature of the water.
ex.cn: 这个小装置能测量水温。
ex.note: a safety device 安全装置；device for doing sth. 做某事的手段

ex.en: His name was on the diploma that hung on the office wall.
ex.cn: 他的名字就写在挂在办公室墙上的那份毕业证书上。
ex.note: a diploma in … ……专业的文凭

ex.en: The teacher dismissed the class early on Friday afternoon.
ex.cn: 老师周五下午提前下课了。
ex.note: dismiss a class 让全班下课；dismiss an idea 不予考虑

ex.en: The book cost ten dollars when it first appeared.
ex.cn: 这本书刚出版时售价十美元。
ex.note: the dollar 美元；dollars 美元（复数）

ex.en: She pinned a drawing of the harbour above her desk.
ex.cn: 她把一幅海港的画钉在书桌上方。
ex.note: drawing 绘画、图画；draw v. 画

ex.en: Each of the students wrote a short report on the novel.
ex.cn: 每个学生都就那本小说写了一份简短的报告。
ex.note: each of … ……每一个；each other 彼此

ex.en: Better lighting improved the efficiency of the whole workshop.
ex.cn: 更好的照明提高了整个车间的效率。
ex.note: efficiency 效率；efficient a. 高效的

ex.en: A trade delegation from the embassy visited the factory.
ex.cn: 大使馆的一个贸易代表团参观了工厂。
ex.note: the Chinese embassy 中国大使馆；embassy staff 大使馆人员

ex.en: The engineers spent three months repairing the old bridge.
ex.cn: 工程师们花了三个月修复那座旧桥。
ex.note: a civil engineer 土木工程师；engineering n. 工程学

ex.en: There was a small error in the figures on the last page.
ex.cn: 最后一页的数字里有个小错误。
ex.note: make an error 犯错；error in judgement 判断失误

ex.en: It is easy to exaggerate the risks of flying.
ex.cn: 人们很容易夸大坐飞机的风险。
ex.note: exaggerate 夸大；exaggeration n. 夸张

ex.en: The rent in the city centre is far too expensive for students.
ex.cn: 市中心的房租对学生来说实在太贵了。
ex.note: 价格高得让人却步；be expensive for sb. 对某人而言太贵

ex.en: The factory now produces parts for wind turbines.
ex.cn: 这家工厂如今生产风力涡轮机的零件。
ex.note: factory n. 工厂；factory worker 工厂工人

ex.en: She wore a fashionable green coat to the ceremony.
ex.cn: 她穿着一件时髦的绿色外套去参加典礼。
ex.note: fashion n. 时尚；in fashion 时髦；become fashionable 开始流行

ex.en: The farmer spread fertilizer over the field before sowing.
ex.cn: 农民在播种前把肥料撒在田里。
ex.note: fertilizer n. 肥料；organic fertilizer 有机肥

ex.en: We grilled fresh fish and corn over the fire.
ex.cn: 我们在火上烤了新鲜的鱼和玉米。
ex.note: fish 作“鱼肉”义时通常不可数

ex.en: He fished for two hours without catching anything.
ex.cn: 他钓了两个小时，一条鱼也没钓上来。
ex.note: fish for sth. 钓鱼；摸索

ex.en: She folded the map carefully and put it in her bag.
ex.cn: 她把地图仔细折好，放进包里。
ex.note: fold sth. up 把某物折起

ex.en: He made a deep fold in the paper and pressed it flat.
ex.cn: 他在纸上折出一道很深的褶痕，又把它压平。
ex.note: a fold in the paper 纸上的褶痕

ex.en: We are going away for a fortnight in the middle of July.
ex.cn: 我们七月中旬要出去两个星期。
ex.note: a fortnight 两星期；in a fortnight's time 两周后

ex.en: Please write your name on the front of the form.
ex.cn: 请把名字写在表格的正面。
ex.note: in front of 在……前面；the front of ……的前部

ex.en: We sat in the front seats so that we could see the stage.
ex.cn: 我们坐在前排座位，这样能看清舞台。
ex.note: front-row seats 前排座位

ex.en: He left his bicycle in the garage behind the building.
ex.cn: 他把自行车放在楼后面的车棚里。
ex.note: garage n. 车库、修车厂；把车开进车库修理

ex.en: The little girl hid behind her father's leg.
ex.cn: 那个小女孩躲在父亲的腿后。
ex.note: a little girl 小女孩；girlhood n. 少女时代

ex.en: The governor opened the new bridge last spring.
ex.cn: 州长去年春天为这座新桥剪了彩。
ex.note: governor n. 州长；总督；主管

ex.en: For a moment there was real grief in the room.
ex.cn: 有那么一会儿，屋里满是真切的悲痛。
ex.note: grief n. 悲痛；in deep grief 沉浸于悲痛

ex.en: The train came to a halt just outside the station.
ex.cn: 火车在车站外不远处停了下来。
ex.note: come to a halt 停下；halt v. 使停止

ex.en: He is the kind of person who keeps his promises.
ex.cn: 他是那种会信守承诺的人。
ex.note: he 是第三人称单数主格

ex.en: A small herd of goats grazed beside the road.
ex.cn: 一小群山羊在路边吃草。
ex.note: a herd of 一群（牛马）；a flock of 一群（鸟羊）

ex.en: His home town is a small fishing village on the coast.
ex.cn: 他的家乡是海边一个小小的渔村。
ex.note: home n. 家；家乡；发源地

ex.en: She walked home along the river after the exam.
ex.cn: 考完试她沿着河边走回家。
ex.note: go home 回家；home adv. 在家

ex.en: However hard he tried, he could not finish on time.
ex.cn: 无论他怎么努力，都没能按时完成。
ex.note: however + adj./adv. 无论多么……；however 置于句首时译作“然而”

ex.en: Professor Chen is ill and cannot come to the reunion.
ex.cn: 陈教授病了，来不了这次聚会。
ex.note: be ill with flu 得了流感；ill health 不健康

ex.en: He spoke ill of his former employer at the meeting.
ex.cn: 在会上他把以前的雇主说得一钱不值。
ex.note: speak ill of sb. 说某人的坏话

ex.en: The improvement in the library has been obvious to everyone.
ex.cn: 图书馆的改善人人都看在眼里。
ex.note: an improvement on 比……有所改进

ex.en: Rising inflation has made everyday life much harder.
ex.cn: 通货膨胀上升让日常生活艰难了许多。
ex.note: inflation n. 通货膨胀；inflation rate 通货膨胀率

ex.en: He did not go home; instead, he stayed and worked late.
ex.cn: 他没有回家，而是留下来加班到很晚。
ex.note: instead of doing 而不是做；instead 单独用表“反而/代替”

ex.en: She had an interview with the head of the department.
ex.cn: 她和系主任面谈了一次。
ex.note: a job interview 求职面试；give an interview 接受采访

ex.en: A young engineer from the alumni office interviewed them for the magazine.
ex.cn: 校友办公室的一位年轻工程师为他们做了杂志采访。
ex.note: interview sb. 采访某人

ex.en: They listened to jazz in a small café near the harbour.
ex.cn: 他们在港口附近的一家小咖啡馆里听爵士乐。
ex.note: jazz n. 爵士乐；a jazz band 爵士乐队

ex.en: He put the kettle on and waited for the water to boil.
ex.cn: 他把水壶放上去烧，等水开。
ex.note: put the kettle on 把水壶放上炉子

ex.en: We walked around the lake before it got dark.
ex.cn: 天黑前我们沿着湖边走了一圈。
ex.note: around the lake 沿着湖边；a salt lake 咸水湖

ex.en: The former class leader is now a manager in a local company.
ex.cn: 从前的班长如今在一家本地公司当经理。
ex.note: leader n. 领导者；leadership n. 领导能力

ex.en: The water level in the reservoir has dropped sharply.
ex.cn: 水库水位急剧下降。
ex.note: at the level of 在……的水平上

ex.en: The path was level all the way to the top of the hill.
ex.cn: 这条路一路平直通到山顶。
ex.note: level 指“平的”；on a level with 与……齐平

ex.en: She majors in modern Chinese literature at university.
ex.cn: 她在大学主修中国现当代文学。
ex.note: literature n. 文学、文献；scientific literature 科学文献

ex.en: The music was so loud that nobody could hear the announcement.
ex.cn: 音乐声太大，谁都听不清广播里的通知。
ex.note: loud adj. 响亮的；loudly adv. 大声地

ex.en: The cost of maintenance has doubled in the past five years.
ex.cn: 过去五年维护费用翻了一番。
ex.note: maintain v. 维护；保养；maintenance cost 维护费用

ex.en: They watched a football match together at the old restaurant.
ex.cn: 他们在老餐馆一起看了一场足球比赛。
ex.note: a football match 一场足球比赛；a box of matches 一盒火柴

ex.en: The colour of your coat does not match your shoes.
ex.cn: 你外套的颜色和你的鞋不配。
ex.note: match sth. with sth. 与……相配

ex.en: The frost on the roofs began to melt after sunrise.
ex.cn: 日出后，屋顶上的霜开始融化。
ex.note: melt into 融化于；melt down 熔化

ex.en: The government promised a million yuan for the factory.
ex.cn: 政府答应给这家工厂一百万块钱。
ex.note: a million 一百万；millions of 数百万

ex.en: The moist earth smelled of fertilizer after the rain.
ex.cn: 雨后，湿润的泥土散发着肥料的气味。
ex.note: moist 指“湿润的”；damp 指“潮湿的”

ex.en: The branches moved slowly across the surface of the water.
ex.cn: 树枝的影子缓缓在水面上移动。
ex.note: move 移动；搬家；感动

ex.en: It was a wise move to leave the bus and walk the last mile.
ex.cn: 最后一段路下车步行是个明智的决定。
ex.note: a move 行动、举措；move house 搬家

ex.en: He felt, for a moment, like a visitor in his own native place.
ex.cn: 有那么一刻，他觉得自己在故乡倒成了客人。
ex.note: native to 本国的；土生土长的

ex.en: The guide was a native of the village and knew everyone.
ex.cn: 那位导游是本地人，村里人人都认识。
ex.note: a native of ……的本地人；native speaker 母语者

ex.en: The task was difficult; nevertheless, they finished it on time.
ex.cn: 任务很难，但他们还是按时完成了。
ex.note: nevertheless = however 然而，连接两个分句

ex.en: He was not angry, only disappointed.
ex.cn: 他不是生气，只是失望。
ex.note: not 否定动词或形容词；not … but … 不是……而是……

ex.en: The biggest obstacle in his way was his own fear.
ex.cn: 挡在他路上最大的障碍，是他自己的恐惧。
ex.note: obstacle to sth. ……的障碍；overcome an obstacle 克服障碍

ex.en: Talking to oneself in the dark is a lonely habit.
ex.cn: 在黑暗里跟自己说话，是一种孤独的习惯。
ex.note: by oneself 独自；dress oneself 给自己穿衣服

ex.en: She organized the reunion and sent out dozens of emails.
ex.cn: 她张罗了这次聚会，发出了几十封邮件。
ex.note: organize an activity 组织活动；organizer n. 组织者

ex.en: The bus overtook us just before the bridge.
ex.cn: 公共汽车在过桥前追上了我们。
ex.note: overtake 超过、赶上；突然降临（不愉快的事）

ex.en: Write one paragraph for each of the three questions.
ex.cn: 三道题每题写一个段落。
ex.note: paragraph 首段；a paragraph of rules 一段规则

ex.en: The pattern of the branches moved across the water.
ex.cn: 枝桠投在水面的影子缓缓移动。
ex.note: pattern n. 模式、图案、榜样；a pattern of behaviour 行为模式

ex.en: Perhaps we should leave a little earlier than usual.
ex.cn: 也许我们该比平时早走一会儿。
ex.note: perhaps = maybe 也许；perhaps not 未必

ex.en: They spread a cloth under the tree and began their picnic.
ex.cn: 他们在树下铺开一块布，开始野餐。
ex.note: have/go on a picnic 去野餐；picnic basket 野餐篮

ex.en: The afternoon was pleasant, with a warm sun and a light wind.
ex.cn: 下午天气宜人，阳光温暖，风也轻柔。
ex.note: pleasant 指“令人愉快的”；pleased 指“感到愉快的”

ex.en: A few ducks were swimming near the edge of the pond.
ex.cn: 几只鸭子在池塘边游着。
ex.note: pond n. 池塘；pool n. 水池

ex.en: A pound of meat cost almost nothing in 1990.
ex.cn: 一九九〇年，一磅肉几乎不值钱。
ex.note: pound n. 磅；英镑；in half a pound 半磅

ex.en: He pounded the table with his fist in anger.
ex.cn: 他生气地用拳头砸桌子。
ex.note: pound the table 捶桌；pound the door 砰砰敲门

ex.en: The pressure of exam season had made everyone tense.
ex.cn: 考试季的压力让所有人都紧绷起来。
ex.note: under pressure 处于压力之下；pressure cooker 高压锅

ex.en: Do not pressure him into accepting the offer.
ex.cn: 别逼他接受那份工作。
ex.note: pressure sb. into doing 迫使某人做某事

ex.en: The whole process takes about three hours.
ex.cn: 整个流程大约需要三个小时。
ex.note: in the process of 在……的过程中；a learning process 学习过程

ex.en: The system processes hundreds of applications a day.
ex.cn: 这套系统每天处理数百份申请。
ex.note: process data 处理数据

ex.en: Beans and eggs are cheap and rich in protein.
ex.cn: 豆类和鸡蛋既便宜又富含蛋白质。
ex.note: be rich in protein 富含蛋白质

ex.en: Put the basket under the tree and spread a cloth on the grass.
ex.cn: 把篮子放在树下，在草地上铺开一块布。
ex.note: put away 收好；put off 推迟；put up with 忍受

ex.en: The students were chosen at random from the whole class.
ex.cn: 学生是从全班随机抽取的。
ex.note: at random 随机地；random chance 偶然的机会

ex.en: He showed us an old receipt from 1990 to prove his point.
ex.cn: 他给我们看了一张一九九〇年的旧收据来证明他的说法。
ex.note: receipt n. 收据；收到（书面通知）

ex.en: She refused to accept the offer without asking her family.
ex.cn: 她没跟家里商量就拒绝了那个提议。
ex.note: refuse to do 拒绝做；refuse sb. sth. 拒绝给某人某物

ex.en: The change in the village over ten years was remarkable.
ex.cn: 这十年间村里的变化十分惊人。
ex.note: remarkable 表示“显著的、非凡的”

ex.en: The university has a residence for students from other provinces.
ex.cn: 这所大学有一座供外省学生住宿的宿舍。
ex.note: residence 住所、居住；in residence 驻校

ex.en: The introduction of the new machine was a real revolution.
ex.cn: 新机器的投入使用是一场真正的革命。
ex.note: revolution n. 革命、巨变、旋转；revolutionary a. 革命性的

ex.en: The small restaurant was dark and romantic.
ex.cn: 那家小餐馆昏暗而浪漫。
ex.note: romantic 也可指“不切实际的”

ex.en: He lowered the saddle and checked the tires.
ex.cn: 他把车座调低，检查了轮胎。
ex.note: saddle n. 马鞍；车座；自行车座

ex.en: She scanned the page quickly and put the book down.
ex.cn: 她飞快地扫了一眼那一页，就把书放下了。
ex.note: scan a document 扫描文件；scan for sth. 搜索某物

ex.en: They rode their bicycles to the seaside in the afternoon.
ex.cn: 下午他们骑车去了海边。
ex.note: go to the seaside 去海边；seaside resort 海滨度假地

ex.en: The two paths were separated by a stream in those days.
ex.cn: 那时两条小径被一条小溪隔开。
ex.note: separate A from B 把 A 和 B 分开

ex.en: Each of us paid for our own separate ticket.
ex.cn: 我们每个人都付了自己那份车票钱。
ex.note: separate adj. 分开的、单独的

ex.en: She was wearing a green coat and carrying a drawing.
ex.cn: 她穿着一件绿色外套，手里拿着一幅画。
ex.note: she 是第三人称单数主格

ex.en: The little girl was shy among so many strangers.
ex.cn: 在这么多陌生人中间，那个小女孩很怯生。
ex.note: be shy of 害怕；羞于；shy away from 回避

ex.en: A new building now stands on the site of the old gym.
ex.cn: 旧体育馆的原址上如今立着一栋新楼。
ex.note: the site of ……的原址；a website 一个网站

ex.en: A student smashed a bottle in the basement by mistake.
ex.cn: 一个学生不小心在地下室打碎了一个瓶子。
ex.note: smash sth. 打碎某物；smash into 撞上

ex.en: Some of us were tired, but nobody wanted to go home.
ex.cn: 我们中有一些人累了，可没人想回家。
ex.note: some of … ……中的一些；some … and others others 有人……有人……

ex.en: The first spark of the project came from a simple idea.
ex.cn: 这个项目的第一点火花来自一个简单的想法。
ex.note: spark 也可指“引发物”

ex.en: A chance meeting sparked a friendship that lasted for years.
ex.cn: 一次偶遇点燃了一段延续多年的友谊。
ex.note: spark a debate 引发一场争论

ex.en: A local company agreed to be the sponsor of the dinner.
ex.cn: 一家本地公司答应做这次晚宴的赞助人。
ex.note: sponsor n. 赞助者；发起人

ex.en: The university sponsors a music festival every spring.
ex.cn: 这所大学每年春天赞助一场音乐节。
ex.note: sponsor v. 赞助；发起

ex.en: The newspaper printed a page of statistics about inflation.
ex.cn: 报纸登了一整版关于通货膨胀的统计数字。
ex.note: statistics n. 统计学、统计数据（常作复数）

ex.en: Each person leaves a story behind them.
ex.cn: 每个人都会在身后留下一个故事。
ex.note: story 也可指“报道”；“楼层”美式英语用 story，英式用 storey

ex.en: He kept telling himself that he was stupid.
ex.cn: 他不断对自己说他很蠢。
ex.note: be stupid about 在……上犯傻；it is stupid of sb. to do 某人做某事很傻

ex.en: The sun was rising behind the hills.
ex.cn: 太阳正从山后升起。
ex.note: the sun 太阳；sunlight n. 阳光

ex.en: A lamp was suspended above the old computer.
ex.cn: 那台旧电脑上方悬着一盏灯。
ex.note: suspend sth. 悬挂某物；suspend judgement 暂缓判断

ex.en: A tall new building stood where the old gym had been.
ex.cn: 旧体育馆原来的位置上立起了一栋高楼。
ex.note: tall 指高度；big/size 指体积

ex.en: He was tempted to make a speech, but he resisted the temptation.
ex.cn: 他很想讲几句话，却抵住了这份诱惑。
ex.note: be tempted to do 禁不住想做某事；on temptation 受诱惑

ex.en: A guide explained the theory behind the new instrument.
ex.cn: 一位讲解员解释了这种新仪器背后的原理。
ex.note: in theory 理论上；theoretical a. 理论上的

ex.en: He felt the old thrill of being part of something larger.
ex.cn: 他重新感到那种属于某个更大整体一部分的激动。
ex.note: a thrill of joy 一阵喜悦

ex.en: The news that she had won the scholarship thrilled the whole family.
ex.cn: 她拿到奖学金的消息让全家都兴奋不已。
ex.note: thrill sb. 使某人激动

ex.en: The little shop sold tobacco, tea and mobile phones.
ex.cn: 那家小店卖烟草、茶叶和手机。
ex.note: tobacco n. 烟草；烟草行业

ex.en: A fishing boat traced a white line across the water.
ex.cn: 一艘渔船在水面上划出一道白线。
ex.note: trace 追踪；追溯；描绘

ex.en: Each place leaves a trace in the memory of those who leave it.
ex.cn: 每一个地方都会在离开过它的人心里留下痕迹。
ex.note: not a trace of 一点痕迹也没有；a trace of anxiety 一丝不安

ex.en: The trend of the market has turned, and demand has fallen.
ex.cn: 市场趋势已经转变，需求下降了。
ex.note: a trend towards 朝……的趋势；the trend of affairs 形势

ex.en: The road twisted along the cliff above the water.
ex.cn: 那条路沿着水面上方的悬崖弯弯曲曲。
ex.note: twist 扭；拧；歪曲

ex.en: A twist in the rope made the boat swing round.
ex.cn: 绳子一拧，船就转了向。
ex.note: twist n. 扭转、曲折；a twist in the plot 情节的转折

ex.en: No two fingerprints are exactly the same, and each is unique.
ex.cn: 没有两枚指纹是完全相同的，每一枚都是独一无二的。
ex.note: unique to sb./sth. 某人所独有的

ex.en: He usually leaves such decisions to chance.
ex.cn: 这类事他通常交给运气。
ex.note: usually = generally 通常；as usual 和往常一样

ex.en: We travelled via Beijing and arrived two days late.
ex.cn: 我们经由北京走，结果晚到了两天。
ex.note: via prep. 经由；通过（某渠道）

ex.en: An extinct volcano rose from the water like a sleeping animal.
ex.cn: 一座死火山像一头沉睡的动物，从水里升起。
ex.note: an extinct volcano 一座死火山；erupt 喷发

ex.en: There is no easy way to learn a language well.
ex.cn: 要把一门语言学好，没有轻松的办法。
ex.note: in this way 以这种方式；in every way 在各方面

ex.en: They say you can see a whale from the cliffs in spring.
ex.cn: 他们说春天从悬崖上能看见鲸鱼。
ex.note: a blue whale 一头蓝鲸；whale watching 观鲸

ex.en: The volleyball captain came with his wife and a small daughter.
ex.cn: 排球队长带着妻子和一个小女儿来了。
ex.note: wife n. 妻子；husband n. 丈夫

ex.en: The factory now employs a few hundred workers.
ex.cn: 工厂如今雇着几百名工人。
ex.note: skilled worker 技术工人；factory worker 工厂工人

ex.en: They sat on the grass and watched the yellow flowers.
ex.cn: 他们坐在草地上，看着那些黄色的花。
ex.note: yellow n. 黄色；turn yellow 变黄
